title: Fuel Economy and Efficiency
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the F70's fuel economy as good or excellent, while a smaller set call it poor and many fragments mention fuel economy without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise fuel economy as good, very good, excellent, or inexpensive to run.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe fuel economy as bad or poor.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews say fuel economy can be a selling point for some buyers but also note it as a weak point or not very good.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention fuel economy without enough context to tell whether the opinion is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The sampled evidence is limited, so concrete negative and undetermined examples are sparse.
Examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative estimates.
This topic is coherent around fuel economy, but many undetermined fragments are too short to show the specific concern or praise.
